description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractDataType and related classes and objects for internal data type representations in Apache Spark SQL, including type collections, numeric types, interval types, and utility objects.

classes.name: AbstractDataType
classes.description: A non-concrete data type reserved for internal use, serving as a base for specific data types.

classes.name: TypeCollection
classes.description: A collection of AbstractDataType instances with precedence, used to specify type constraints.

classes.name: AnyDataType
classes.description: An object matching any concrete data type, used internally.

classes.name: AtomicType
classes.description: An abstract class representing atomic data types such as numeric, timestamp, or interval types.

classes.name: NumericType
classes.description: An abstract class for numeric data types.

classes.name: IntegralType
classes.description: An abstract class for integral numeric types.

classes.name: FractionalType
classes.description: An abstract class for fractional numeric types.

classes.name: AnyTimestampType
classes.description: Represents timestamp types, including timestamp with and without time zone.

classes.name: AnyTimeType
classes.description: Represents time types of any valid precision.

methods.name: defaultConcreteType
methods.description: Returns the default concrete DataType for the AbstractDataType.

methods.name: acceptsType
methods.description: Checks if a given DataType is acceptable for this type.

methods.name: simpleString
methods.description: Provides a human-readable string representation of the type.
